verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; no STOP (no confirmed memory-safety defect left unrepaired, no ABI regression, no hidden obligation and no remaining unsafe-safe-Rust API); three secret-handling failure-path improvements, one authority stack-overflow non-reproduction, one NULL-dereference refusal, two allocator-seam coordinate repairs and one checked-arithmetic repair
scope: Per-file contract audit of the PEM X509 and X509_AUX reader/writer expansions, PKCS12_item_pack_safebag, the PKCS7 pack/unpack helpers in p12_add, the four PKCS#12 ASN.1 item groups and their ADB tables, the ten PKCS#12 attribute helpers, PKCS12_PBE_keyivgen_ex's key/IV derivation, PKCS12_pbe_crypt_ex and the four item crypt spellings, and PKCS12_init_ex. evp/method_store.rs was deferred as the method-store registry boundary; p12_init.rs was substituted from position 9 of the queue. PKCS#12 passwords, derived keys and the DER encodings of private-key bags are SECRET_DATA; salts, iteration counts, algorithm identifiers and ciphertext are PUBLIC_DATA. No constant-time claim is made for any file from source inspection.

files_not_run.reason: Method-store registry and OSSL_METHOD_CONSTRUCT_METHOD dispatch boundary (store locking, construct/reserve/unreserve callbacks, method cache). Deferred for a dedicated boundary audit; it remains in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt at the head of the queue.

defects.class: unchecked c_int length sums sizing an allocation
defects.description: max_out_len = inlen + block_size and max_out_len += mac_len were unchecked c_int sums; an overflowing or negative sum would size the OPENSSL_zalloc block below the bytes EVP_CipherUpdate writes. The authority wraps; AGENTS.md section 17 forbids reproducing that.
defects.fix: Both sums use checked_add with a non-negative filter and refuse (free the context, answer NULL) before allocating.
defects.witness: Source comparison with crypto/pkcs12/p12_decr.c:54,65,81; cargo check --lib and the full library suite pass.

defects.class: allocator-seam file/line coordinates disagree with the authority
defects.description: FILE used the short crypto/pkcs12/p12_decr.c spelling, and the CipherFinal/GET_TAG failure releases reported lines 92/105; the admitted build's __FILE__ is ../../src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/pkcs12/p12_decr.c and the authority's OPENSSL_free(out) calls are at p12_decr.c:93 and :108. The strings are observable to a caller-installed CRYPTO_set_mem_functions hook.
defects.fix: FILE now carries the admitted spelling; the two failure releases use :93 and :108. The :85, :171, :211 and :216 coordinates already matched.

defects.class: secret-bearing failure path freed without cleansing
defects.description: On every PBE failure after EVP_CipherUpdate the authority frees the output block without cleansing, although the decrypt arm's prefix is plaintext. PKCS12_item_i2d_encrypt_ex likewise frees the encoded plaintext without cleansing when zbuf != 0 and the crypt fails (p12_decr.c:211).
defects.fix: OPENSSL_cleanse of the full allocation (or inlen for the encoding) runs before each plain release; release coordinates are unchanged. Recorded as a deliberate failure-path improvement over the authority.

defects.class: hidden precondition: cipher key/IV length must fit the authority's stack arrays
defects.description: key and iv are EVP_MAX_KEY_LENGTH/EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH stack arrays filled with EVP_CIPHER_get_key_length/_iv_length bytes. A caller-supplied cipher advertising more overruns them in the authority; the documented contract required only a live cipher.
defects.fix: The two lengths are read once; a cipher with klen > 64 or ivlen > 16 is refused after the parameter decode is freed and before deriving. No raise is invented and no error-queue coordinate changes.
defects.witness: crypto/pkcs12/p12_crpt.c:31,51,60; built-in PBE table ciphers are all within the bounds.

defects.class: derived secret left uncleansed on failure returns
defects.description: Both derivation-failure returns left the secret key (and iv) array uncleansed on the stack; the authority does the same at p12_crpt.c:56 and :65.
defects.fix: Both failure arms cleanse both fixed arrays before returning; the success path keeps the authority's two cleanses at :73-74.

defects.class: documented live PKCS7 can have a NULL encrypted content object
defects.description: PKCS12_unpack_p7encdata checked d.encrypted for NULL and then dereferenced enc_data. A live PKCS7 with a NULL content object satisfies the documented contract and would fault; the authority has the same gap at p12_add.c:166.
defects.fix: A NULL enc_data is refused at the existing decode-error coordinate PKCS12_ADD_162 (PKCS12_R_DECODE_ERROR); no new error site.

defects.class: unsafe # Safety contract understates the namelen == -1 / attribute-validity preconditions
defects.description: The five add helpers documented name as readable for namelen bytes, but namelen == -1 makes ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID measure the string, so the contract permitted a non-NUL-terminated buffer. PKCS12_get_friendlyname did not state that a present V_ASN1_BMPSTRING value is well formed.
defects.fix: Contracts now state the NUL-termination requirement for namelen == -1 and the well-formed-attribute precondition. No code or ABI change.

defects.class: allocator-seam file coordinate disagrees with the authority
defects.description: The PKCS12_free propq member-slot seam reported the short crypto/pkcs12/p12_asn.c spelling rather than the admitted build's ../../src/openssl-3.6.4/... __FILE__.
defects.fix: FILE now carries the admitted spelling; the release line 35 already matched p12_asn.c:35.

residuals: src/evp/method_store.rs remains the deferred method-store registry boundary.
PKCS12_item_decrypt_d2i_ex still frees a decrypted plaintext without cleansing when the caller passes zbuf == 0; that is the authority's contractual choice and is preserved.
PKCS12_pbe_crypt_ex hands its plaintext to the caller without a length-attached cleansing release; the exported ABI makes the caller the owner.
The p12_add pack paths trust the item layer union invariants (PKCS7_set_type establishes d.encrypted); the added test covers the content pointer a C caller can tamper with.
The PKCS#12 KDF and the provider PKCS12KDF row are outside this batch.
No constant-time claim is made for the PKCS#12 units from source inspection.

boundary_control.reason: M62-D4's refusal is unreachable through the built-in PBE table (no public way to construct an EVP_CIPHER with key_len > 64), M62-D1's checked sum needs inlen near INT_MAX, and no harness observes the CRYPTO_* file/line strings for these units. Miri/ASan/valgrind, an allocator-coordinate differential, dudect/ctgrind and the negative controls are BOUNDARY/SEAL work.
